zoe (People Ops): FYI - discovered a mismatch between interviewer timezone in ATS profile and calendar invites after vendor import. Example: Interviewer INT-220 shows timezone America/Los_Angeles in profile but invites being sent in UTC.
ben (Recruiting): saw that too, had candidates RSVP at odd hours because of it. Which import is this tied to?
nats-import-bot: import job id=job-5132 source=vendor-X status=completed rows=210 warnings=4
ben (Recruiting): vendor-X again. They changed header `tz` -> `timezone_id` in last export. Our importer ignored the new header and defaulted to UTC.
matt (Eng - Integrations): hmm we have a fallback that sets timezone to UTC when field missing. We should instead prefer the profile's existing timezone or vendor-provided value if present. I'll patch importer to look for `timezone_id`, `tz`, or `time_zone`.
training-ops-bot: reminder: interviewer re-cert training cohort 22 starts next Monday.
zoe (People Ops): blocking issue: some interviewers didn't receive cohort invites because the importer updated their profile with the wrong timezone which caused calendar creation to be outside working hours and our availability filter rejected those slots.
ben (Recruiting): immediate fix: matt can re-run calendar sync for affected interviewers after importer hotfix. Also can we add a preflight validation that flags timezone values not in IANA list?
matt (Eng - Integrations): yes will add validation and an alias map. Quick plan: 1) add header aliases for timezone, 2) validate against IANA tzdb, 3) if missing, fallback to existing profile timezone instead of UTC. Deploying hotfix now (hotfix-602).
zoe (People Ops): also let's add a human-readable warning to the importer report so recruiting sees which fields changed.
nats-import-bot: hotfix-602 deployed at 2026-04-01T08:12:33Z. Re-run scheduled for 2026-04-01T08:30:00Z on interviewers [INT-220, INT-312, INT-415].
ben (Recruiting): re-run complete - invites regenerated and manual follow-up messages sent to affected candidates. All good on my side.
zoe (People Ops): adding a checklist item: "confirm timezone header mapping on vendor CSVs" to hiring-ops runbook. Also will ping vendor channel to remind them to keep header stable.
nats-import-bot: job-5132 warnings: unknown header `timezone_id` (alias mapped).
nats-import-bot: report attached: 3 profiles updated, 0 invites failed.
zoe (People Ops): closing this thread but keeping note in runbook. :white_check_mark:
